turns.doctor_question: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Well, I guess what brings me in is that for the past year or so, I feel like I’m always doing something—puttering around, fixing things, arranging things, signing up to help with one more thing. Even at 87, I have a hard time just sitting down and being still.
